sources.title: Tipsv2 L14 Dpt - AI Model Insights & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Deep dive into Tipsv2 L14 Dpt. TIPSv2 — L/14 DPT Heads DPT (Dense Prediction Transformer) heads for depth estimation, surface normal prediction, and semantic segmentation on top of the frozen TIPSv2 L/14 backbone. The backbone is loaded automatically. The depth and normals heads are trained on the NYU Depth V2 dataset and segmentation is trained on the ADE20K dataset (150 classes).

sources.snippet: If you've been hunting for a robust, openly licensed monocular depth estimation model that plays nicely with Huawei's Ascend ecosystem, your search just got a bit more interesting. Google's TipS v2 (Tip-Server v2) L14-DPT has landed on Modelers.cn, the Huawei/Ascend AI platform. sources.title: GitHub - google-deepmind/tips: TIPSv2 (CVPR'26) and TIPS (ICLR'25)
sources.snippet: We provide both Pytorch and Jax (Scenic) implementations: tips/pytorch/: PyTorch inference for the model. tips/scenic/: Jax-based inference using the scenic library. We provide links to all available checkpoints, for both Pytorch and Jax model definitions, together with representative evals. You can also find TIPSv2 models on HuggingFace here.
